correctness.rationale: All-length symbolic proof counts disjoint commuting histories then partitions the constant-source histories by the number t of complementary symbols in the second window. Different t yield different b counts; positive t yields distinct first-b-run profiles, and t=0 has exactly binomial(max(n-2k+2,0),2) duplicate pairs. Verified small-source enumeration and longer constant-source tests agree, but are not used as infinite proof.
